problem: Busy slash lines are queued on mainQueue and run when the turn ends, but every drain site shifts ONE item and relies on a later turn-settle to shift the next. A queued slash command that starts no turn (/compact, /model, /goal, /connect) ends without a settle, so every line queued behind it stays in mainQueue.
impact: While a turn runs, '/compact' then 'continue with the review' leaves the second line stuck; the operator's next typed line runs ahead of it (order inversion). In an unattended trust-mode run a queued slash line silently stops the queue.
suggested_fix: Deferred, not fixed in this closing round. Follow-up: after runQueued runs an item that starts no foreground operation, drain the next item (shared drainNext helper used by the three sites), stopping once an item starts a turn. Add a headless test that queues ['/compact', 'question'] and asserts the question is dispatched.
